findings.title: Fit workers are omitted from the promised terminal observation
findings.evidence: Frozen v4 supervise.py lines72-77 records child_pid and reap_observed, but not child_start_ticks. The conjunctive field test therefore never adds any fit worker to handles. owner_and_children_terminal/observed_owned_handles overstates the actual worker observations.
findings.required_fix: Preserve frozen scientific source. Explicitly handle positive fit child_pid without invented start ticks: conservatively require that recorded PID absent/terminated, or rely on authenticated saved reap authority with clearly labelled observation scope. Do not silently omit the worker. Resource terminals do contain child_start_ticks and can retain exact PID/tick checks. Never signal an original scientific/resource job.

findings.title: Relative waits do not enforce the stated absolute stage cap
findings.evidence: The1800-second wait begins after launch/identity/owner-write work; cleanup adds two relative5-second waits. A normal zero exit is accepted regardless of elapsed_seconds>1810. Cleanup timeout or a natural-exit race at the same_live assertions can also bypass the stage terminal record.
findings.required_fix: Use monotonic deadlines began+1800 and began+1810, remaining-time waits and a finally terminal receipt carrying actual exit/reap/elapsed/cap_exceeded. Recheck child.poll around natural exit before signalling, retain exact owned-process-group guards, reject any observed overrun or unreaped child, and keep no retry.
